summary: Verification round. review-scope.mjs exited 0: 2 of 47 blocks changed (pr-code, pr-steps-start; 3%), and no section or objective changed. The previous review had no open must-fix items, so there are no resolved entries. I reviewed both changed blocks in full. pr-code splits the echo line with a ` \` continuation to fit 390 px. pr-start adds 「`\` で終わる行は、次の行と合わせて1つのコマンドです。」, which is accurate and keeps the instruction to run one line at a time from breaking the redirect. The 「練習：」 rule the practice checks is unchanged, so nothing regressed. Two new niceToHave items: mention the `>` continuation prompt, and restore 「…で始める」 in the rule, since the split removes the width reason for the short form. I re-scored prior, load, practice and accuracy (unchanged at 3). The other criteria are carried over. lessons:validate and lessons:lint --strict are clean (0 errors, 0 warnings). measure.mjs: prose 1945, practice reading 1152, est 19.9 min against estMinutes 20. Every criterion is 3 or above, the mean is 3.46 and there are no must-fix items, so the verdict is pass.
